purpose: Descriptive vehicle-local historical-use evidence for charge planning, with explicit provenance, evidence gates and limitations; not battery diagnosis or a promised outcome.
primaryGoal: Compare tomorrow-first seven-day SoC scenarios against a selected planning reserve while understanding current-state trust and historical support.

dataSources.behavior: Vehicle-scoped history key; enabled only with vehicle; inherited moderate stale policy; AbortSignal forwarded; safeArray selection. No start/end bounds supplied. Model qualifies returned rows into a frozen 180-day vehicle-local window.
dataSources.limitations: Backend ordering, complete coverage, actual payload and parameter handling were not exercised or traced beyond registration.

dataSources.behavior: Independent vehicle-scoped history key, enablement, cancellation and moderate stale policy; safeArray selection. Charging energy remains Wh until useUnits().formatEnergy at rendering.
dataSources.limitations: Exactly 1000 rows signals a capped observed window, not lifetime completeness.

dataSources.behavior: REST initial read and reconnect invalidation plus realtime updates feed merged live state. Page supplies battery percentage, observed time, charging status, charge limit and connectivity to the pure model.
dataSources.limitations: SSE transport implementation and live backend freshness enforcement were not inspected. Shared hook currently exposes aggregate signal presence and browser receipt time rather than per-field observed provenance.

dataSources.sourceOwner: Existing workspace, formatting and data-trust owners
dataSources.behavior: Shared header owns vehicle. /charge-advisor is not RANGE_ENABLED_PATHS and has no competing local vehicle/date picker. Reserve floor is a separate business planning control, initially 20%, with 10/20/30 choices.
dataSources.limitations: Underlying selected-vehicle, timezone and unit preference implementations not independently audited; preserve them rather than inventing replacement state.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Repeated label/value/detail metric tiles also occur in CurrentState:52, ChargingProfile:70 and FrequencySupport:30, with page-local typography overrides. KPI/accounting already use BatteryEvidenceBrief instead.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Reuse existing metric presentation/role wrappers only where they preserve all specialist captions and null semantics; keep provenance cards and weekday business structures local where not equivalent. Do not create another BatteryMetricCard.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Drive and charging accounting columns repeat the summary/category layout, with separate provenance and category labels.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: If edited, use a feature-local typed renderer preserving both sources, all row categories, counts and independent source states.

evidence: ChargeAdvisorPage.tsx:138 uses flex-wrap for reserve action; :165-188 uses three CardGrid pairs.
ChargeAdvisorWeekdayProfile.tsx:28 uses 2/4/7 columns; ChargingTiming.tsx:37 uses 4/7 weekday cells.
ScenarioChart.tsx:60 and DailyTrend.tsx:59 set chart heights 290/270 while ResponsiveContainer uses allocated width.

issues.detail: Seven dense weekday cards at xl, and two at narrow widths, carry long captions/badges; clipping and minimum-content pressure are plausible but not demonstrated.
issues.fix: Exercise allocated-width layouts, long translations and 200% text at all ten widths; adjust wrapping/min-width or grid breakpoints without removing metadata.

evidence: ChargeAdvisorPage.tsx:139-149 supplies explicit Select id, localized label and aria-label.
KpiBand.tsx:96 supplies section aria-label; :130 uses existing retry Button.
ScenarioChart.tsx:44-59 and DailyTrend.tsx:45-58 provide chart aria labels and explicit data-table columns.
Decorative domain icons carry aria-hidden; freshness, support and connectivity have text, not color alone.

issues.detail: Reserve control requests small sizing; actual touch target, keyboard, focus, overflow and accessible Select association are unverified, not a confirmed failure.
issues.fix: Measure composed mobile target and test native selection, keyboard/focus and long labels before accepting; reuse existing Select sizing contract if inadequate.

states.initialLoading: Per-history availability/loading flags preserve independent drive/charging sections; SourceContent skeleton height 180 and KPI OperationalBrief loading suppression.
states.empty: No vehicle retains all section shells with select-vehicle explanation. Scenario/trend have explicit no-qualified-evidence explanations; null statistics use em dash.
states.fatalError: KPI QueryError and retry; dependency-specific section unavailability messaging. Successful neighboring drive-only/charging-only sections remain.
states.refreshError: useDataState separates fatal from refresh; loaded arrays remain, warning/retry shown in KPI, BatteryEvidenceBrief marked retained.
states.stale: Model derives current-state freshness and blocks actionable guidance when stale; historical fallback default maximum age two days. Aging/field provenance weaknesses listed below.
states.offline: Connected/disconnected/unknown retrieval and connection text shown; paused/offline query state is not represented in page's simplified ChargeAdvisorQueryState.
states.partial: Drive and charging availability tracked separately, but both-dependent sections currently hide available partial content.

issues.detail: Any missing required source replaces all children. Accounting and methodology both declare dependency='both'; a failed charging read removes loaded drive accounting and static methodology. Historical current fallback also requires both even when only one valid source supplied it.
issues.fix: Render accounting sources independently, keep static methodology reachable and gate current provenance by its actual selected source; retain explicit unavailable messages rather than infer missing counts.

issues.detail: Source DataStates are reduced to loading/available/error; paused/offline, stale age and last-success metadata are not forwarded to sections. Retained histories can appear ready without source-specific age.
issues.fix: Carry existing source trust evidence into the domain view and retain data while visibly distinguishing paused/offline, stale and refresh-failure states; do not create a second query-state engine.

visualIssues.detail: Every profile value is fixed cyan-300; repeated informational icons and metrics throughout the page use fixed cyan. No neon/glow or pure-white text was found by scoped pattern checks, but muted fixed accents still override neutral/theme-aware hierarchy.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing primary/secondary/metric semantic text tokens for ordinary values and neutral decorative icons. Reserve semantic warning/success hues for meaningful statuses, keep saved chart palette choices and existing series distinctions.

visualIssues.detail: Text receives text-2xl/font-semibold; BurnDistribution:40 uses text-lg and FrequencySupport:32 uses text-xl. These override typography roles and spread metric emphasis across many panels.
visualIssues.fix: Adopt existing MetricValue/MetricLabel/Caption or an equivalent accepted metric contract while preserving labels, source age, unknown states, precision and user typography preferences.

visualIssues.detail: Mean/p75 text uses fixed cyan/amber rather than existing chart series tokens; consistency across chart palette preferences and light theme remains unverified.
visualIssues.fix: Prefer neutral numeric text with explicit mean/p75 labels or restrained palette-derived markers; preserve dashed/solid chart differentiation and all scenario values.

architectureIssues.detail: Aggregate signalCount>0 marks battery, charge limit and charging status as known. useVehicleLive.ts:185 initializes batteryLevel to 0; :255 only sets it when BatteryLevel exists. A snapshot containing unrelated signals can therefore produce a valid-looking 0% live candidate. :474/:500 stamp browser receipt time and do not preserve per-field observation time.
architectureIssues.fix: Use the canonical signal evidence owner for field-level presence and observed timestamps; leave absent SoC/charge fields null and block guidance when freshness is unknown. Do not alter SI/cache values or substitute browser receipt time for measured freshness.

architectureIssues.detail: Inspected hook holds merged state across vehicleId changes and has no reset/vehicle-bound state identity in lines 447-506. Page immediately reuses it for the newly selected vehicle. Previous vehicle SoC may temporarily drive new vehicle planning until a new snapshot arrives.
architectureIssues.fix: Shared live owner must expose vehicle-bound signal evidence and suppress prior-vehicle payload on scope changes while preserving reconnect recovery, cancellation and known-value merging within one vehicle.

architectureIssues.detail: currentStateNowMs advances only when liveUpdatedMs changes (:53-58). No elapsed-time invalidation exists here, so silent/disconnected state age and guidance can remain frozen. Model :1058-1066 also uses the same two-day fallback threshold for live candidates, despite current live trust needing independently established freshness.
architectureIssues.fix: Keep the intentionally frozen historical analysis/calendar clock, but derive current-state trust from canonical live age and advance only its aging clock independently. Preserve historical two-day fallback semantics and evidence gate; require integration agreement for live freshness rather than silently changing business calculations.

priority.reason: Resolve field-level live trust and vehicle isolation before cosmetic adoption; then preserve independently available evidence and restrained typography/palette.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Vehicle-bound nullable live signal evidence
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Expose vehicle identity, BatteryLevel/charge-limit/charging field presence, original per-field observed time and stale/unknown state; keep existing legacy-facing values if other consumers require them. Do not infer measurement availability from signalCount or receipt timestamp.
dependsOn: Verify existing canonical live/evidence API and backend timestamp contract before choosing additive shared exposure
Preserve SSE reconnect recovery and raw SI payloads
requiredSharedChanges.limitation: Only this assigned consumer was inspected; no claim of a multi-consumer new-composite requirement.

competingImplementations.detail: Local metric tiles coexist with existing OperationalBrief metric pipeline; they are a presentation inconsistency, not evidence that every domain tile is safely replaceable.
competingImplementations.fix: Reuse accepted metric roles where equivalent and preserve specialist local structures where equivalence is unproved; no new stats engine.

preservation.sourceHashBasis: Live root file bytes, not history or archived receipt
preservation.lineCountScope: Page plus 14 TSX files under components\charge-advisor; excludes domain lib, type/barrel and BatteryEvidenceBrief.
preservation.sectionCountEvidence: Page JSX lines 154-192: thirteen rendered ChargeAdvisor sections. A naive '<ChargeAdvisor[A-Z]' pattern returned 14 because it also matched the generic ChargeAdvisorLiveSnapshot type at line 66.
preservation.layoutCardExplanation: One KpiBand and reusable ChargeAdvisorSection, instantiated for twelve other domain sections; declaration count is not section count.
actions: Existing chart toolbar/fullscreen/export capabilities exposed by EmbeddedChart
Scenario mean/p75 legend visibility through stable chartKey
dataBehavior: Keep 1000-row source caps and independent history-cap warnings; do not turn capped counts into lifetime totals.
Preserve 180-day vehicle-local calendar window and intentionally frozen analysis clock; seven complete days begin tomorrow.
Preserve valid 0% observations while never fabricating them from absent signals.
Preserve exclusive row-accounting categories, drive qualification, positive SoC-drop/gain requirements, local-day aggregation and calendar zero-driving denominators.
Keep all mean/median/p75/p90/min/max summaries, weekday support metadata, charging timing and valid energy-row counts.
Keep planning-reserve distinction, support gate of 28 observed calendar days / 8 active days / 4 active weeks, charging precedence and explicit methodological omissions.
Keep raw Wh and duration seconds; energy conversion remains useUnits display-only. Percentage points are not total energy.
Preserve localized strings, timezone, selected-vehicle owner, query keys/cancellation/cache policy, retained data and individual retry.
Do not automatically add a date picker or re-scope this fixed-methodology analysis to the shared range without an explicitly agreed behavior change.

evidenceLimits.auditMode: Phase 0 read-only source inspection; only assigned JSON and heartbeat written. No source, shared, queue, Git, production or configuration mutations.
evidenceLimits.runtime: NOTRUN: no mounted browser, backend requests or production actions
evidenceLimits.visual: NOTRUN: no screenshots, composed contrast, actual theme or viewport checks
evidenceLimits.typeScript: NOTRUN: no validation baton; assignment is source-only audit
evidenceLimits.lintBuildTests: NOTRUN: no full builds/lint/tests. Skill audit.sh inspected but not executed because its unconditional TypeScript step exceeds this read-only audit protocol.
evidenceLimits.existingTests: chargeAdvisor.test.ts test names inspected, including timezone/DST, clocks, accounting, caps, freshness and no-mutation cases; not run and not borrowed as current acceptance.
evidenceLimits.backend: Route registration inspected only; list sorting/filter enforcement, actual live freshness and payload contracts remain unverified.
evidenceLimits.shared: Shared component internals and unrelated consumers not audited; caller props establish intended capabilities, not runtime behavior.
